Package ro.sync.ecss.extensions.dita

Class DITANodeRendererCustomizer

java.lang.Object
ro.sync.exml.workspace.api.node.customizer.XMLNodeRendererCustomizer
ro.sync.ecss.extensions.dita.DITANodeRendererCustomizer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Extension
@API(type=INTERNAL, src=PUBLIC) public class DITANodeRendererCustomizer extends XMLNodeRendererCustomizer
Class used to customize the way a DITA node is rendered in the UI. A node represents an entry from Author outline, Author bread crumb, Text page outline, content completion proposals window or Elements view.
